source_interpretation: Appendix Table 5 nctx=3000 consists of a 1500-context random pilot for nuisance training followed by the Section 7 n=1500 acquisition sample.
fixed_command: uv sync --frozen && uv run python repro/run_all.py
requirements: Tune a global binary LightGBM nuisance model on the independent pilot with the paper's 30-draw, three-fold data-collection search grid.
Design separate Borda, BT, and Rank Centrality A-optimal policies on fresh contexts from pilot-trained predictions.
Use the pilot-trained nuisance in the EIF estimator for both A-optimal and budget-matched random acquisition.
Run 15 deterministic repetitions at beta=2000 and report MSE times 100.
Require A-optimal mean MSE below random for every GARS and all six observed Monte Carlo intervals to overlap the v1 paper intervals.
Require exact expected budgets, nonnegative influence weights, optimal objectives, and rejection of a budget-matched inverted-information control.
